# EndfieldHUD 1.0.1
- Added Traditional Chinese and Japanese throughout the interface. Language selection now uses the same animated list as display selection. - Enlarged the menu-bar icon and removed the two older crystal/gem icon choices. Saved icon preferences remain compatible. - Added English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese READMEs, with installation, permissions, screenshots and animated previews using sample data. - Improved localized label sizing and refreshing when switching languages.
## Install or update
Download **EndfieldHUD-1.0.1-macOS.dmg**, drag **EndfieldHUD.app** to **Applications**, eject the disk image, then open the installed app. The default summon hotkey is **Control + backtick**. Existing installed release copies can use **Check for Updates** in the menu bar or About. Your settings and saved data are retained.
The ZIP contains the same universal app. A source ZIP and SHA-256 checksums are included.
**Requirements:** Apple silicon/macOS 11+ or Intel/macOS 10.15.4+. Per-app volume requires macOS 14.2+ and System Audio Recording permission. Automatic Focus requires macOS 13+ and two user-created Shortcuts; see the README setup steps.
The app is ad hoc signed and **not Apple-notarized**. macOS may require its per-app **Open Anyway** approval. Live testing is on an M2 MacBook Air with macOS 15.7.4; other hardware and OS versions have not received equivalent live coverage.
Instructions: [English](https://github.com/DDDuoDuo/EndfieldHUD/blob/v1.0.1/README.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/DDDuoDuo/EndfieldHUD/blob/v1.0.1/README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](https://github.com/DDDuoDuo/EndfieldHUD/blob/v1.0.1/README.zh-TW.md) · [日本語](https://github.com/DDDuoDuo/EndfieldHUD/blob/v1.0.1/README.ja.md)
Original code: MIT. Unofficial fan project; game artwork belongs to its respective owners. See [credits](https://github.com/DDDuoDuo/EndfieldHUD/blob/v1.0.1/CREDITS.md).
---
新增繁體中文和日语，语言选择改为与显示器选择相同的列表。菜单栏图标加大，移除两个旧版结晶图标，并新增四种语言的安装说明、截图及动画预览。已有设置和保存的数据会保留。
新增繁體中文與日文，語言選擇改為與顯示器選擇相同的清單。選單列圖示加大，移除兩個舊版結晶圖示，並新增四種語言的安裝說明、截圖及動畫預覽。既有設定與儲存的資料會保留。
繁体字中国語と日本語に対応しました。言語は画面の選択と同じ形式の一覧から選べます。メニューバーのアイコンを大きくし、古い結晶アイコン2種類を選択肢から削除しました。4言語のREADMEにインストール手順、スクリーンショット、アニメーションを追加しました。設定と保存済みのデータは引き継がれます。

# EndfieldHUD 1.0
The first stable release of EndfieldHUD, an unofficial Endfield-inspired macOS HUD.
- Notes, temporary file shelf, clipboard, app shortcuts, map and personal card. - Work Mode, volume controls, battery/device information, Storage and Activity Monitor. - Configurable appearance, display selection and summon hotkey. - Update checks in the menu bar and About, new-release notifications, and signed automatic updates for installed release copies. - Final navigation polish: “便笺” and “剪贴板” labels, restored Activity Monitor chart icon, and balanced bottom-button icons.
## Download and install
Download **EndfieldHUD-1.0.0-macOS.dmg**, drag **EndfieldHUD.app** to **Applications**, eject the disk image, and open the installed app. The default summon shortcut is **Ctrl + backtick**. The ZIP contains the same universal application; the source ZIP and SHA-256 checksums are also included.
Apple silicon requires macOS 11 or later; Intel requires macOS 10.15.4 or later. Live testing has been performed on an M2 MacBook Air running macOS 15.7.4. Other hardware and older supported systems have not received equivalent testing.
The application is **ad hoc signed and not notarized**; macOS may require its per-app “Open Anyway” approval. See [installation and compatibility](https://github.com/DDDuoDuo/EndfieldHUD/blob/v1.0.0/docs/testing-build.md).
Per-app volume requires macOS 14.2+, System Audio Recording permission, and compatible audio hardware. Automatic Focus requires macOS 13+ and the user's two configured Shortcuts; installing the app does not install those shortcuts. See [Focus setup](https://github.com/DDDuoDuo/EndfieldHUD/blob/v1.0.0/docs/audio-and-work-mode.md#automatic-focus-setup).
Update signatures, packaging and update coordination are verified. A live upgrade between published updater-enabled versions has not yet been exercised; this is the first release that includes that updater.
Original code: MIT. Game artwork belongs to its respective owners; see [credits](https://github.com/DDDuoDuo/EndfieldHUD/blob/v1.0.0/CREDITS.md).
---
首个正式版本。下载 DMG 后，将应用拖入“应用程序”，推出磁盘映像，再打开应用。默认快捷键为 **Control + `**。
此版本包含便笺、文件暂存架、剪贴板、应用快捷方式、地图、个人名片、工作模式、音量、电量、存储及活动监视器，并提供检查更新、更新通知和签名自动更新。
应用尚未经过 Apple 公证。各功能的系统要求、专注模式快捷指令配置及已验证范围见上方说明。非官方同人项目。
